title: Reducing friction in ARC Raiders
body:
# Reducing friction in ARC Raiders

As a development team, one of our biggest priorities is making sure every moment you spend in ARC Raiders feels purposeful. Your time matters, and we don't want you clicking through menus when you could be out raiding instead.

That's why we pay close attention to what you tell us. One piece of feedback has come up again and again: "I'm spending too much time crafting".

# **Missing materials**

Many of you pointed out that tracking down missing materials for a craft took more effort than it should. You already knew where to find what you needed, whether by recycling something you had on hand or buying it from Celeste, but having to move through multiple screens to actually get it done was a real pain point. That friction was getting in the way of the fun.

# **What we've done about it**

We've built a streamlined way to acquire missing materials right from the crafting screen. Now, when you're short on something for a craft, you'll see a new **Acquire Resources** button. Tap it, and you'll get a clear list of every available source for what you need, whether that's recycling, buying from Celeste, or another method, so you can close the gap and finish your craft without breaking your flow.

The key word is available: if a material can be obtained through your current options, it will show up, and you can act on it right away. No more digging through menus. No more giving up on a craft out of frustration.

# **Just the start**

We know this doesn't solve everything. Streamlining crafting goes deeper than a single button, and we're continuously looking at what to tackle next. Our team will keep working through these pain points systematically, and you can expect more improvements soon.

Thank you for continuing to share your feedback. It directly shapes what we prioritize and how we build. Keep it coming.

All the best,

The ARC Raiders UI/UX Team
